title: 第二十三章重返皇城第二十四章 紫徽湖
content_zh:
;;
秦枫目光平静，开口道：“他所需要的，对我们而言，算不得什么。”
秦翊站在一旁，闻言微微点头，沉吟道：“那两只灵犬，你也可以交由他培养。不至元婴不退凡，我们要做的事情太多。”
秦枫闻言，嘴角勾起一抹若有若无的笑意。他手腕一翻，一个古朴的兽皮袋出现在掌心，正是养兽袋。心念一动，养兽袋口微微张开，两道身影如同离弦之箭般窜了出来，落在地上，发出两声清脆的“汪呜”声。正是那对黑白灵犬。小黑通体乌黑，毛发如绸缎般光滑，唯有额间一点雪白；小白则一身雪白，纤尘不染，眼眸灵动，宛如两颗黑宝石。
秦枫指尖灵光一闪，体内灵力缓缓涌动。他屈指一绕，两道复杂玄奥的符文在指尖迅速勾勒而成。符文呈淡金色，流转着神秘的光泽，隐隐间仿佛有古老的兽吼在符文深处回荡。
“御兽符，禁！”低喝一声，秦枫指尖轻弹，两道符文如同流光般飞出，精准地没入了黑白灵犬的眉心。
“呜！”两只灵犬身体微微一颤，随即眼中闪过一丝清明，原本略显稚嫩的气息，似乎沉稳了几分。它们亲昵地蹭了蹭秦枫的裤腿，小尾巴欢快地摇摆着。
秦枫微微一笑，从储物戒中取出早已准备好的妖兽肉食。这些肉食都经过处理，蕴含着浓郁的气血之力，最适合灵犬现在的阶段。肉块一落地，小黑和小白立刻扑了上去，大口大口地撕咬起来，吃得满嘴流油，小尾巴摇摆得如同风中的蒲扇，还不时抬头看一眼秦枫，发出满足的呜咽声。看着它们吃得香甜，秦枫眼中闪过一丝柔光。待两只灵犬吃饱喝足，秦枫并没有再将它们收回养兽袋，而是挥了挥手，任由它们在院子里追逐嬉戏。
“走吧，去地下牢房。”秦翊开口道，语气沉稳。
秦枫点头，兄弟二人并肩朝着院落一角的密室走去。那里，有通往地下牢房的入口。
一日后，当他们再次返回院落时，以是傍晚，却发现院内多了一道身影。姬行之正蹲在地上，与两只灵犬玩闹得不亦乐乎。
他一身白色罗裙，面容秀美，此刻却毫无修仙者的高冷，任由小黑和小白在他身上乱蹭，时不时还伸手挠挠它们的下巴。两只灵犬似乎也十分喜欢这位新“朋友”，围着他转来转去，发出欢快的叫声。看到这一幕，秦枫眼中闪过一丝笑意，调侃道：“哥，姬长老好像特别喜欢和你相处啊。”
秦翊闻言，顿时一瞪眼，没好气道：“就你嘴多！”他自然听出了秦枫话中的弦外之音。
秦枫嘿嘿一笑，也不在意，转而说道：“我还有点事要处理，哥，小黑和小白就拜托你暂时帮忙喂养一下了。”话音落下，他不等秦翊回应，身形一闪，如同离弦之箭般窜出了院落，眨眼间便消失在夜色之中。
“这小子……”秦翊无奈地摇了摇头，目光却不由自主地落在了姬行之的身上。
姬行之也注意到了他，站起身来，微微一笑，道：“你回来了。”
秦翊点了点头，神色恢复了一贯的沉稳，道：“姬长老，让你久等了。”
“无妨。”姬行之摆了摆手，目光落在那两只依旧在撒欢的灵犬身上，眼中带着一丝喜爱，“这两只小家伙，倒是挺有趣的。”
……
秦枫离开内院后，径直朝着老祖所在的内院走去。老祖正坐在石桌旁，品着香茗，神色淡然。

“枫儿，你来了。”老祖抬眼看了他一眼，开口道。
“见过老祖。”秦枫恭敬地行了一礼。
老祖摆了摆手，示意他坐下。秦枫向老祖要了三滴生命灵泉，数瓶灵品培元丹，还有一颗灵品筑基丹。生命灵泉，乃是天地孕育的奇物，对身体有着难以想象的滋养之效。灵品培元丹，有助于稳固修为，提升灵力。而灵品筑基丹，则是炼气修士梦寐以求的宝物，能够极大地提升筑基成功的几率，并且打下更加坚实的灵基。
这些东西，每一样都价值不菲，老祖却毫不犹豫地给了他。秦枫又与老祖交谈了几句，这才告辞离开。
……
当秦枫再次返回自己的内院时，夜色已经深沉。姬行之已经离开了，院落中只剩下秦翊一人。秦翊正坐在石凳上，手中拿着一块妖兽骨头，逗小黑和小白。两只灵犬叼得津津有味，时不时还发出亲昵的叫声。看到秦枫回来，便放下手中的骨头，站起身来。
“回来了？”秦翊开口道。
秦枫问道：“姬长老呢？”
“已经回去了。”秦翊答道，顿了顿，又有些意犹未尽地说道，“马上就要离开临海城了，登云酒楼的美酒，还有不少没尝过呢。”
秦枫微微一怔，随即似笑非笑地看着他，道：“是她的意思，还是你的意思？”
秦翊嘴硬道：“我只是想喝酒了。”
秦枫见状，不再戳破，哈哈一笑，道：“好！既然大哥想喝，那我就陪你！”
……
在接下来的日子里，临海城的登云酒楼，多了一道风景。三个书生模样的公子哥，经常结伴而来，身后还跟着两只灵动可爱的灵犬。为首的两人，气质卓然，正是秦翊和秦枫。而跟在他们身边的第三人，虽然也是一身书生打扮，面容俊朗，但眉宇间却隐隐透着一丝难以掩饰的英气。此人，正是女扮男装的姬行之。三人在登云酒楼的雅间内饮酒畅谈，谈论修行心得，点评临海城的风土人情，相处得倒也融洽。
姬行之酒量不俗，谈吐风趣，与秦翊、秦枫之间的关系，也在一次次的推杯换盏中，变得愈发亲近。时间，就在这样轻松惬意的日子中，悄然流逝。
……
一个月后。这一日，临海城的天空格外晴朗，阳光明媚。秦翊、秦枫收到老祖传令后。传音给隗无悔速去广场集合，并整理好行装，带着小黑和小白，朝着临海城广场行去。秦军主早已率领左右两军，在广场上列阵完毕。城主刘仁轨、平州仙坛坛主丁原、平州碧云商会会主尤亦文等人，也都亲自来到了广场，为老祖送行。看到秦枫和秦翊到来，老祖微微点头道：“时间差不多了。”声音不大，却清晰地传遍了整个广场。
“出发！”随着一声令下，大家井然有序地登上了飞舰。飞舰缓缓升空，向北方驶去。站在飞舰的甲板上，秦枫回头望去。临海城的轮廓，在视线中逐渐变小。飞舰的速度极快，风驰电掣般穿梭在云层之间。三日之后。飞舰的速度渐渐慢了下来。秦枫等人纷纷走出船舱，来到甲板上。只见前方的天际，一座巨大的雄城，如同沉睡的上古巨兽，雄踞在大地之上。
紫徽城！皇城！飞舰缓缓停在皇城内的紫徽广场上。老祖率先走下飞舰，秦翊和秦枫紧随其后。
当秦枫再次踏在紫徽城的土地上时，他的心中，涌起一股难以言喻的感觉。离开时，他还是一个嗷嗷待哺的婴儿。如今再回故土，他已经成长为一个意气风发的少年。紫徽城依旧雄峙，只是不曾有旧时的时光记忆。

Qin Feng's eyes were calm and he said, "What he needs is nothing to us."
Qin Yi stood aside, nodded slightly when he heard the words, and said thoughtfully: "You can also leave those two spiritual dogs to him for training. We have too many things to do until the Nascent Soul is immortal."
When Qin Feng heard this, a faint smile appeared at the corner of his mouth. He turned his wrist, and a simple animal skin bag appeared in his palm. It was an animal raising bag. With a thought in his mind, the mouth of the animal bag opened slightly, and two figures shot out like arrows from the string, fell to the ground, and made two crisp "woof" sounds. It was the pair of black and white spirit dogs. Xiao Hei's body is jet black, and his hair is as smooth as satin, with only a little white on his forehead; Xiao Bai is all white, spotless, with lively eyes, like two black gems.
Qin Feng's fingertips flashed with inspiration, and spiritual power surged slowly within his body. He circled his fingers, and two complex and mysterious runes were quickly outlined on his fingertips. The runes were pale gold in color, exuding a mysterious luster, and there seemed to be an ancient roar of beasts faintly echoing deep within the runes.
"Beast Control Talisman, Forbidden!" With a low voice, Qin Feng flicked his fingertips, and two runes flew out like streams of light, accurately sinking into the black and white spirit dog's eyebrows.
"Woo!" The bodies of the two spirit dogs trembled slightly, and then a trace of clarity flashed in their eyes. Their originally slightly childish aura seemed to be a little calmer. They rubbed Qin Feng's trouser legs affectionately, their little tails wagging happily.
Qin Feng smiled slightly and took out the monster meat that had been prepared from the storage ring. These meats have been processed and contain rich energy and blood, which is most suitable for the current stage of the spirit dog. As soon as the piece of meat fell to the ground, Xiao Hei and Xiao Bai immediately pounced on it and started to bite into it with big mouthfuls. Their tails swayed like cattail fans in the wind. From time to time, they looked up at Qin Feng and let out a satisfied whimper. Seeing them eating deliciously, Qin Feng's eyes flashed with a soft light. After the two spirit dogs had eaten and drank enough, Qin Feng did not put them back into the animal bag, but waved his hand and let them chase and play in the yard.
"Let's go to the underground cell." Qin Yi said in a calm tone.
Qin Feng nodded, and the two brothers walked side by side towards the secret room in the corner of the courtyard. There, there is an entrance to the underground cell.
One day later, when they returned to the courtyard again in the evening, they found an additional figure in the courtyard. Ji Xingzhi was squatting on the ground, playing happily with the two spirit dogs.
He was dressed in a white skirt and had a beautiful face, but at this moment he did not have the aloofness of an immortal cultivator. He allowed Xiao Hei and Xiao Bai to rub against him, and from time to time he would reach out and scratch their chins. The two spirit dogs also seemed to like this new "friend" very much. They circled around him and barked happily. Seeing this scene, Qin Feng flashed a smile in his eyes and said jokingly: "Brother, Elder Ji seems to really like getting along with you."
When Qin Yi heard this, he immediately glared and said angrily: "You are the only one who talks a lot!" He naturally heard the hidden meaning in Qin Feng's words.
Qin Feng chuckled and didn't care, and said instead: "I still have something to deal with. Brother, I will ask you to help feed Xiao Hei and Xiao Bai for a while." After the words fell, he did not wait for Qin Yi to respond. He flashed out of the courtyard like an arrow from a string, and disappeared into the night in the blink of an eye.
"This kid..." Qin Yi shook his head helplessly, but his eyes fell on Ji Xingzhi involuntarily.
Ji Xingzhi also noticed him, stood up, smiled slightly, and said, "You're back."
Qin Yi nodded, his expression returned to his usual calmness, and said: "Elder Ji, I have kept you waiting for a long time."
"It doesn't matter." Ji Xingzhi waved his hand, his eyes falling on the two spirit dogs who were still having fun, with a hint of affection in his eyes, "These two little guys are quite interesting."
…
After Qin Feng left the inner courtyard, he walked straight towards the inner courtyard where his ancestor was. The ancestor is sitting at the stone table, tastingHe was drinking fragrant tea and looking calm.
"Feng'er, you're here." The ancestor looked up at him and said.
"I've met ancestor." Qin Feng bowed respectfully.
The ancestor waved his hand and motioned for him to sit down. Qin Feng asked his ancestor for three drops of the Life Spirit Spring, several bottles of Spiritual Grade Yuan-Building Pills, and a Spiritual Grade Foundation-Building Pill. The spring of life is a miraculous thing bred by heaven and earth, and has an unimaginable nourishing effect on the body. The Spiritual Quality Peiyuan Pill helps stabilize cultivation and enhance spiritual power. The spiritual foundation building pill is the treasure that Qi refining monks dream of. It can greatly increase the chance of successful foundation building and lay a more solid spiritual foundation.
Each of these things was valuable, but the ancestor gave it to him without hesitation. Qin Feng chatted with the ancestor for a few more words before saying goodbye and leaving.
…
When Qin Feng returned to his inner courtyard again, the night was already dark. Ji Xingzhi has left, and Qin Yi is the only one left in the courtyard. Qin Yi was sitting on the stone bench, holding a monster bone in his hand, teasing Xiao Hei and Xiao Bai. The two spirit dogs enjoyed the food in their mouths and barked affectionately from time to time. When he saw Qin Feng coming back, he put down the bones in his hands and stood up.
"Come back?" Qin Yi said.
Qin Feng asked: "Where is Elder Ji?"
"I've gone back." Qin Yi replied, paused, and then said with some unfinished meaning, "I'm leaving Linhai City soon. There are still many fine wines in Dengyun Restaurant that I haven't tasted yet."
Qin Feng was slightly startled, then looked at him with a smile but not a smile, and said, "Is it her intention or yours?"
Qin Yi said hard: "I just want to drink."
When Qin Feng saw this, he stopped poking fun at it, laughed, and said: "Okay! Since eldest brother wants to drink, then I will accompany you!"
…
In the days that followed, Dengyun Restaurant in Linhai City gained an additional sight. The three scholar-like young men often come together, followed by two smart and cute spirit dogs. The two leaders, with outstanding temperaments, were Qin Yi and Qin Feng. The third person following them, although he was also dressed as a scholar and had a handsome face, had a hint of heroic spirit that was difficult to conceal between his brows. This person is none other than Ji Xingzhi, who is disguised as a man. The three of them drank and talked in the private room of Dengyun Restaurant, talking about their cultivation experiences and commenting on the customs and customs of Linhai City, and they got along well.
Ji Xingzhi drinks well and talks humorously. The relationship with Qin Yi and Qin Feng has become closer and closer through changing glasses time and time again. Time passes quietly in such a relaxing and comfortable day.
…
One month later. On this day, the sky in Linhai City was exceptionally clear and the sun was shining brightly. After Qin Yi and Qin Feng received the order from their ancestors. A message was sent to Wei Wuhui to quickly gather in the square, pack up his luggage, take Xiao Hei and Xiao Bai, and head towards Linhai City Square. The Qin army leader had already led the left and right armies to form an array in the square. City Lord Liu Rengui, Pingzhou Immortal Altar Lord Ding Yuan, Pingzhou Biyun Chamber of Commerce Head You Yiwen and others also came to the square in person to see the ancestor off. Seeing Qin Feng and Qin Yi arriving, the ancestor nodded slightly and said: "It's almost time." The voice was not loud, but it spread clearly throughout the square.
"Let's go!" Following the order, everyone boarded the spaceship in an orderly manner. The airship slowly took off and headed north. Standing on the deck of the spaceship, Qin Feng looked back. The outline of Linhai City gradually becomes smaller in sight. The speed of the airship was extremely fast, flying through the clouds like lightning. Three days later. The speed of the airship gradually slowed down. Qin Feng and others walked out of the cabin one after another and came to the deck. In the sky ahead, he saw a huge majestic city, like a sleeping ancient beast, standing majestically on the earth.
Purple Hui City! Imperial City! The airship slowly stopped at the Zihui Square in the Imperial City. The ancestor was the first to step off the spaceship, followed closely by Qin Yi and Qin Feng.
When Qin Feng stepped on the land of Zihui City again, an uneasy feeling surged in his heart.The feeling of metaphor. When he left, he was still a baby waiting to be fed. Now that he has returned to his hometown, he has grown into a high-spirited young man. Zihui City is still majestic, but there is no memory of the old days.
